query:
CREATE TABLE `postShares` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `postId` int NOT NULL,
  `shareType` enum('facebook','whatsapp','copy_link') NOT NULL,
  `sharedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `userAgent` text,
  `ipAddress` varchar(45),
  CONSTRAINT `postShares_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  INDEX `postId_idx` (`postId`),
  INDEX `shareType_idx` (`shareType`)
);
